title: psila densa
intro: Psila densa, commonly known as the Yellow Horned Poppy or Black-eyed Susan, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Psila densa include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Psila densa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
